verdict.rationale: An LLM API gateway could plausibly let requests attach MCP servers as tool sources, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows OpenRouter publishing its own MCP server for other assistants to connect to, which is the server role, plus generic tool calling, which is a developer building block. Neither shows OpenRouter acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
